### [416] [Designing Collaborative Virtual Environments for Software Engineering Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14578)
*Filipe Fernandes,Cláudia Werner*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Collaborative virtual environments offer opportunities to make software models available for shared inspection, but educational design and usability need to be examined separately from claims of learning effectiveness. This article presents MetaSEE, an approach connecting requirements guidance, a Web XR feature model, a reusable UML component, and a browser-based multiuser platform. We synthesize documented formative evaluations of the framework (16 participations), feature model (15), UML component (9), and platform (14). These counts represent evaluation participations; the same 12 developers took part in the first two evaluations. The principal platform study involved six teachers working individually and eight students working in four pairs through desktop or notebook computers, keyboard, and mouse. The documentary synthesis traces educational intentions to implemented features and reported difficulties. Participants identified potential value in shared modeling and simulation, alongside navigation, interaction, visualization, and distraction concerns. A numerical audit reconstructs a student System Usability Scale mean of 67.50 from published item frequencies, conflicting with the reported 79.38; an incomplete teacher item distribution prevents recovery of that group's overall mean. The contribution is a traceable account of educational design and formative limitations, with practical implications for onboarding, model readability, collaboration, and evaluation reporting. The evidence supports bounded feasibility and perceived usefulness, without establishing learning gains, sustained engagement, or adoption.

### [417] [Discovering the Relation Between Architectural Models and Reference Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14606)
*Thi Dinh Tran,Maria Teresa Rossi,Ludovico Iovino,Leonardo Mariani*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Assessing whether concrete software architectures are consistent with their reference architecture (RA) is essential to ensure that architectural decisions scale coherently across projects, preserving the quality attributes the RA was designed to guarantee. In the absence of dedicated techniques, mapping the components of an architectural model onto a predefined RA can be addressed only with general-purpose model-comparison algorithms. Our experiments show that these algorithms are inaccurate when applied to RAs. To address this gap, we propose Reference Architecture Mapping Discovery (RAMD), an LLM-based workflow that combines model analysis with structured prompting, and refines results through an iterative RA compliance-checking mechanism. We evaluate RAMD on 64 open-source architectural models spanning three RAs from the IoT, self-driving, and smart parking domains. With domain knowledge and GPT-4o, RAMD reaches 85.8% mapping accuracy and outperforms the strongest baseline by 44.6 percentage points, while ensuring structural consistency with the RA.

### [418] [Typify: A Tool for Usage-driven Type Inference in Python](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14879)
*Hassan Aman,Ali Aman,Muhammad Asaduzzaman,Shaowei Wang,Jessica Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Python's dynamic type system, while expressive and flexible, creates significant challenges for static analysis tools in unannotated or partially annotated codebases. Existing approaches either require pre-existing type annotations, or depend on deep learning models that demand large training corpora and significant computational resources. We present Typify, a lightweight, usage-driven static type inference engine that infers precise type information across entire Python projects without annotations or training data. Typify integrates symbolic execution, fixpoint analysis, and context-matching retrieval to propagate types across modules, functions, and recursive call structures. The tool is available as both a command-line interface (CLI) for batch inference, evaluation and downstream integration with other tools, and a Visual Studio Code (VS Code) extension for interactive type assistance. Evaluation on the ManyTypes4Py and Typilus datasets shows that Typify outperforms all static baselines and closely matches state-of-the-art hybrid deep learning approaches, while running approximately 10x faster.

### [419] [Caprese: Change Impact Recommendation Using History and Runtime Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14937)
*Sadjad Tavakoli,Saba Alimadadi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Change impact recommendation identifies program entities potentially affected by source code changes. Historical co-changes and runtime dependencies provide complementary evidence, particularly in JavaScript, where dynamic and asynchronous behaviour complicates dependency analysis. We present Caprese, an open-source framework for function-level change impact recommendation in this http URL . Given a change set, it produces a ranked impact set of potentially affected functions. It supports repository-based recommendation through confidence-guided mining of recurring, change-set-relevant co-change patterns of varying lengths; dynamic recommendation through execution-derived dependencies involving calls, callbacks, events, timers, and shared state; and hybrid recommendation integrating both analyses. Its modular implementation supports reusable analyses. Evaluation on ten open-source applications and 100 selected change sets shows that, on average across projects, 77.4% of the relevant functions among the top 60 hybrid recommendations are identified exclusively by one analysis, demonstrating substantial complementarity. Dynamic recommendation achieves the highest mean precision among the top five recommendations (0.65), while repository-based recommendation performs best when the ranking is extended to 60 recommendations (0.42). Hybrid recommendation outperforms TARMAQ on average but does not consistently outperform the individual modes. Caprese is publicly available with source code, documentation, and evaluation artifacts.

### [420] [TSBugs Explorer: Exploring and Benchmarking TypeScript Bugs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14940)
*TianYi Tang,Saba Alimadadi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Curated datasets of real-world software bugs support empirical research in software testing, debugging, and automated program repair. However, exploring heterogeneous bug collections, comparing fault characteristics across projects, and constructing research-specific subsets often require manual inspection and custom scripts. We present TSBugs Explorer, an interactive visual analytics platform built upon our previously-published dataset of 633 bugs from 16 open-source TypeScript repositories, classified into 11 fault categories. The platform integrates bug records, repository characteristics, dependency information, and taxonomy guidance through coordinated visualizations, interactive filtering, and detailed bug inspection. It supports alternative aggregation and normalization of fault distributions, pairwise repository comparisons, and analysis of differences in observed fault profiles. An integrated benchmark builder allows researchers to select bug subsets using multiple criteria, inspect their composition, and export records in CSV or JSON format. We demonstrate the platform through three research workflows: fault characterization, cross-repository comparison, and task-specific benchmark construction. Functional validation by two authors confirmed selection correctness, visualization consistency, export integrity, and reproducibility across the tested workflows. By making the existing corpus easier to explore, compare, and reuse, TSBugs Explorer facilitates systematic, research-specific selection and export of TypeScript bug records.

### [421] [LOHRE: Execution-Grounded Type Recovery via LLM-Orchestrated Hybrid Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14946)
*Hao Jiang,Yujie Yang,Tao Li,Chenhui Cui,Liangfeng Xu,Chengjie Liu,Weiping Wen,Rubing Huang,Tsong Yueh Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Documenting stripped binary functions for security analysis requires recovering function interfaces and user-defined type (UDT) layouts from machine code. Existing large language model (LLM)-based methods face two limitations: they lack execution-based validation to detect inferred UDTs inconsistent with actual memory layouts, and may overlook evidence about shared UDTs across functions without direct call relationships. We present LLM-Orchestrated Hybrid Reverse Engineering (LOHRE), a framework that treats inferred UDTs as falsifiable hypotheses and tests them against program execution. LOHRE uses a hypothesize-validate-refine loop to test candidate layouts through paired dynamic slice emulation of baseline and mutated inputs. To reduce the cost of processing lengthy execution histories, the Execution-Depth Heuristic (EDH) compresses paired traces into an execution-depth difference and a summary of the tested field's observed uses. A cross-function knowledge base aggregates compatible UDT hypotheses and field-level confidence scores to guide testing and hypothesis refinement. We evaluate LOHRE on RealType at four optimization levels and a Windows remote procedure call (RPC) dataset. LOHRE achieves an average UDT Structural accuracy of 57.85% across RealType's four optimization levels and 35.6% on Windows RPC, outperforming the evaluated static baselines. Disabling dynamic validation reduces accuracy to 19.28% on RealType and 9.2% on Windows RPC. Removing the cross-function knowledge base reduces accuracy to 41.03% on RealType and 10.0% on Windows RPC. Replacing EDH's compressed feedback with full execution traces reduces recovery accuracy while increasing token use by 3.7 times and runtime by 3.0 times. These results indicate that execution-based validation, compact feedback, and cross-function evidence contribute to accurate and efficient UDT recovery.

### [422] [JoyFrontBench: Evaluating Front-End Coding Agents through Goal-Oriented Acceptance Contracts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14952)
*Xiaoyi Qiao,Yicheng Wang,Jianan Lin,Xiaoyang Ji,Dongyi Lv,Yidan Huang,Shi Suo,Shiying Fan,Nan Duan,Jiaqi Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Front-end coding agents are expected to produce applications that fulfill user goals, yet high task scores can coexist with failures in essential workflows. Evaluating these agents therefore requires an explicit distinction between partial implementation and application success. We introduce JoyFrontBench, a benchmark that makes this distinction through goal-oriented acceptance contracts. Each contract identifies core tasks and mandatory criteria before generation: a core task passes only when all mandatory criteria are satisfied and a shared completion threshold is met, while application success requires every core task to pass on the same operational artifact within a single run. Derived from practitioner requirements, JoyFrontBench comprises 100 front-end development problems, 764 tasks, and 2,596 atomic criteria, with reviewed annotations linking user goals to core tasks and evidence requirements. The evaluation framework combines evidence-grounded judgments with deterministic record auditing and fixed scoring rules, preserving graded task assessment alongside explicit core-task and application-level acceptance. We evaluate five coding models under two agent harnesses, OpenHands and OpenCode, on the 70-problem test set; the remaining 30 problems form a public set for validation and diagnostic analyses. Under OpenHands, the mean Average Task Score (ATS) across models is 87.69%, while the mean Application Success Rate (ASR) is 51.52%. Further analyses reveal changes in model rankings across harnesses and variation in application success across repeated runs. These findings highlight the limitations of aggregate task scores in characterizing application success and motivate explicit assessment of core-goal fulfillment alongside graded task performance.

### [423] [GHA-SmellFix: Taking Action with Agentic LLMs for Detecting and Refactoring GitHub Actions Workflow Smells](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14963)
*Anderson Uchôa,Jhefferson Souza,Emanuel Ávila,Gabriel Silva,Kevin Lira,Hui Sun,Nelson Araújo,Arthur Cordeiro,Rohit Gheyi,Wesley Assunção*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Continuous integration and continuous delivery workflows are key artifacts in software projects. In GitHub Actions, they encode build, test, release, deployment, and security automation in YAML. These workflows contain configuration smells affecting security, reliability, maintainability, or operational stability. Existing approaches are mostly rule-based, with rules hard to create and evolve, and typically report findings without fixes. Agentic LLM pipelines can combine contextual detection, transformation selection, and patch generation. Specialized agents can gate refactoring on positive detection verdicts, potentially avoiding unnecessary changes, but it is unclear whether decomposition improves effectiveness or mainly changes overhead. We present GHA-SmellFix, an agentic LLM pipeline for detecting and refactoring GitHub Actions workflow smells. We compare two designs: Joint, where one agent detects and refactors, and Decomposed, where separate agents detect and then refactor. We operationalize 19 smells from an existing catalog with explicit detection criteria, refactoring expectations, exclusion rules, and safety checks, and curate a ground truth of 1,710 (workflow, smell) pairs. We evaluate the designs with four LLMs (GPT-5.4-nano, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Claude Haiku 4.5, and DeepSeek V4 Flash) on 570 sampled pairs. Results show that decomposition does not universally improve patch quality; its main benefit is controlling when patch generation is attempted. It helps models prone to missing smells and can reduce overhead by gating patches. Once a smell is correctly detected, clean refactoring is generally effective, making detection the main end-to-end bottleneck. However, false positives can trigger unnecessary edits to execution-relevant constructs. Practical CI/CD agents thus need reliable abstention and construct-aware validation alongside patch generation.

### [424] [Understanding Suggested Edits in Stack Overflow: A Large-Scale Empirical Study and Review Prioritization Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15001)
*Mehedi Hasan Shanto,Muhammad Asaduzzaman,Md. Ahasanuzzaman,Alioune Ngom*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Suggested edits allow low-reputation users to improve Stack Overflow posts and contribute to the platform's knowledge base. However, we still know little about why these edits are accepted or rejected and how reviewers can efficiently identify problematic edits. In this study, we analyze 3,888,805 suggested edits submitted between 2011 and May 2023. First, we compare accepted and rejected edits using 35 features. We find significant differences between them, with the largest differences related to users' editing history. Second, we manually analyze rejected edits and identify 17 fine-grained rejection reasons. These reasons provide a more detailed understanding of why edits are rejected than Stack Overflow's predefined rejection reasons. Third, we evaluate three models for prioritizing edits based on their likelihood of rejection. The Feature Model, built using the 35 studied features, provides the best trade-off between review rate and rejected-edit recall. At a decision threshold of $\tau = 0.40$, it prioritizes 52.3% of edits for human review while capturing 80.8% of rejected edits. In comparison, the Embedding Model captures 78.8% of rejected edits while prioritizing 60.9% of edits, and the EditEx Model captures 72.5% while prioritizing 59.0%. We also conduct a complementary zero-shot evaluation on a separate set of 500 edits. The Feature Model achieves 78.0% recall at $\tau = 0.40$, compared with 23.6%-31.2% for GPT-4o, Qwen2.5-32B, and Llama-3.3-70B. Overall, our findings provide a detailed understanding of suggested-edit rejection and show that rejection-risk prediction can help prioritize potentially problematic edits for human review.

### [425] [Structure-Aware Quantum Circuit Equivalence Checking via Sparse Pauli Propagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15080)
*Shangzhou Xia,Junjie Luo,Qichen Wang,Yasunari Suzuki,Jianjun Zhao*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Quantum circuit equivalence checking is essential for validating compiler optimizations, but its computational cost can vary substantially with circuit structure. We present a structure-aware equivalence checker for unitary quantum circuits based on sparse Pauli propagation. It combines two complementary verification strategies: generator propagation compares the conjugation actions of the circuits on Pauli generators, while Cut-Miter exploits cancellation between circuit products at selected cut points. A structure-aware verification procedure uses circuit characteristics to select between these strategies while explicitly accounting for numerical and approximation errors. We evaluate our framework against three existing equivalence checkers on two benchmark suites containing circuit pairs with up to 512 qubits. Across 434 scored circuit pairs, our framework produces reference-consistent decisions for 96.3% of the pairs without any incorrect verdicts, while the evaluated baselines achieve at most 68.7% reference-consistent decisions. It also achieves the lowest aggregate runtime among the evaluated tools, reducing total runtime by 48.5%--76.0% relative to these baselines. Ablation studies confirm the benefits of cut-based verification, Pauli-term pruning, and bounded propagation attempts. These results indicate that structure-aware sparse Pauli propagation, combined with complementary verification strategies and explicit error accounting, can provide an effective approach to practical quantum circuit equivalence checking.

### [426] [An Empirical Study of Maintainer-Identified AI Slop Pull Requests in Free and Open Source Software Projects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15159)
*Hugo Raskin,Xavier Devroey,Benoît Vanderose*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: The FOSS ecosystem has always relied on outside contributions, notably through issues or Pull Requests (PRs), to sustain itself. With the advance of GenAI, the barrier to contributing to FOSS projects has never been lower, leading to the emergence of AI slop PRs: low-quality, low-value generated PRs. Past studies have examined AI slop PRs through theoretical, platform-level, or practitioner-account frames, but not at the project level. To this end, this study investigates the incidence of maintainer-identified AI slop PRs in FOSS projects by focusing on PRs flagged as slop by maintainers. Using a mixed-methods approach, we trace the origins of maintainer-identified AI slop PRs, quantify their volume in FOSS projects, describe their characteristics, and highlight maintainers' reasons for flagging or closing them. Our results show that the volume of maintainer-identified AI slop PRs increased in mid-2025, peaking in May 2026. These PRs are mostly additive, rarely merged, and typically closed within 3 days. The authors of these PRs disclosed the use of AI in 14% of cases, with 1% disclosing after a maintainer's request. Most PRs are closed or marked as slop without any reason provided by the maintainer. Based on our open coding, reasons range from concrete elements, like build failures, to ideological or intuitive (i.e., "looks AI to me"). This exploratory study captures a phenomenon in its early stage and highlights GenAI's potential impact on FOSS, emphasizing the pressure it puts on maintainers and the need to shift current open-source development practices.

### [427] [Pre-QED: Environment Specifications for Agentic Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15207)
*Tristan Lim,Haoxin Tu,Mehtab Zafar,Zhengxiong Luo,Abhik Roychoudhury*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: LLM agents are making formal verification practical at scale. Recently, many attempts have raised this as an enticing possibility. However, formal verification at scale is only meaningful if deep formal specifications capturing functionality are available for checking. Unfortunately, recent works seek to bypass this issue by using shallow specifications devised for purposes other than verification. OSS-Verify from Anthropic and Theorem, for example, reuses the fuzz harnesses of open-source libraries as specifications and has an agent prove that each harness never crashes. However, a fuzz harness follows a single sequence of API calls under a single calling context, so the resulting proof covers one usage scenario rather than the library. We argue that the bottleneck of agentic verification has shifted from how to prove to what to prove. Before zooming into verification at scale, we need deep environment specifications to prove, which is why we call our effort Pre-QED. We propose verification harnesses, executable harnesses that model all legal usages of an API, so that a proof about the harness is a proof about every well-behaved client. To construct them, we use an agentic workflow that extracts the API's usage contract from code / documentation, and uses Linear-time Temporal Logic (LTL) to rule out illegal call orders. We identify the challenges in proving verification harnesses and release our harnesses open-source as challenges for the community. The overarching vision is that verifying an open-source library should become as routine as fuzzing it, with a guarantee that covers every well-behaved client rather than a single scenario like a fuzzing harness.

### [428] [Technical Debt Risks in AI-Assisted Software Development: Insights from Practitioners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15310)
*Nazia Jahan,Nafisa Alam,Sourov Debnath,Arafat Rahman,S. M. Waesh Ahmed,Md Farhad Alam Bhuiyan,Mia Mohammad Imran*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: AI coding assistants increasingly support software development, raising concerns about technical debt associated with AI-generated code and development practices. We investigate these concerns through a sequential mixed-methods study involving 137 survey respondents and 20 follow-up interviews with software professionals in Bangladesh. Drawing on ten established technical debt dimensions, we examine perceived risks, contributing circumstances, maintenance consequences, validation practices, and developer understanding. Respondents expressed the strongest concerns about People Debt (73.0\%), Management Debt (70.1\%), and Architecture Debt (68.6\%), suggesting that risks extend beyond code quality. Participants associated ambiguous requirements, insufficient project context, and unrequested AI-generated changes with architectural inconsistencies, rework, and maintenance difficulties. Their experiences revealed contrasting outcomes: AI assistance supported refactoring, maintainability improvements, and testing, but also introduced rework and context misalignment. Although 89.8\% reported regularly verifying AI-generated code, participants expressed concerns about AI dependence, reduced code understanding, and review effort. They also emphasized the need for stronger architectural awareness, requirements clarification, and validation support in coding assistants. Our findings suggest that managing technical debt risks requires attention to project context, implementation decisions, and developer understanding alongside generated code quality.

### [429] [AgentTorrent: A Dataset of Context and Harness Engineering Artifacts on GitHub](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15436)
*Sebastian Baltes,Seyedmoein Mohsenimofidi,Levi Böhme,Vahram Nersesyan,Muhammad Auwal Abubakar,Jai Lal Lulla,Matthias Galster,Christoph Treude*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Over the past months, developers have moved from formulating detailed prompts to engineering the context that agentic coding tools read and to configuring the underlying harnesses. For example, developers commit context files, skills, hooks, and MCP configurations to their repositories, and these files control which instructions a harness reads and which actions it can take. Developers may also commit the specs, plans, and task files that agentic coding tools and spec-driven development frameworks write for agents to implement. The AgentTorrent dataset records these files for six proprietary and open-source agentic coding tools in 10,944 engineered software projects on GitHub. It contains 62,374 configuration artifacts, the files that these artifacts import, 27,593 agentic planning documents, and more than 1.2 million commits that credit an AI tool. All heuristics used for data collection are grounded in tool documentation or derived from GitHub repositories, and we evaluate their detection accuracy with each collection. We use open-weight models to classify whether GitHub repositories host engineered software projects. Unlike most datasets, AgentTorrent links configuration artifacts, imported files, agentic planning documents, and commits that credit an AI tool within the same repositories. Configuration artifacts, planning documents, and credited commits occur together in 388 repositories. For example, our dataset allows researchers to study whether a tool is credited in commits that add instructions for that same tool and how instruction files import and contradict each other. Our data collection pipeline supports regular updates and automatically checks vendor documentation and reports unknown artifacts and agentic coding tools. The dataset and the pipeline are open-source and are archived on Zenodo.

### [430] [KernelMutate: Mutation-Guided Validation of Generated GPU Kernels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15441)
*Ziyuan Li,Zihe Song,Shuxiao Xie,Mingfang Ji,Xiaofang Qi,Wei Yang,Tao Xie*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Generated GPU implementations are commonly accepted after a few differential tests, although replacement obligations may remain unchecked. We present KernelMutate, an empirical study of validation reliability using controlled faults, released implementations, and replacement tests. A five-draw anchor accepts 548 of 838 CUDA candidates. The full suite finds native FP32 witnesses for 136 accepted candidates and dtype-only findings for another 362, mostly low-precision execution limitations without established publisher guarantees. Source-guided testing identifies the full suite's 692 candidates at 26.1% lower charged cost, but yields only dtype evidence for 16 accepted candidates with native witnesses in the full suite. Independently observed context and boundary findings cover the same candidate set. Task-held-out template matching reveals differences in ranking and observation coverage: global top-eight recommendations match more probes than class-conditioned lists (51 versus 48 of 75), while conditional analyses restrict the apparent advantage at smaller limits. These template-matching results are offline measurements, not deployed-suite gains. Independent controls and replacement cases expose numerical-policy, binding, and custom-execution boundaries. Validation therefore needs to report witness domains and observation coverage alongside candidate yield and cost.

### [431] [KernelAudit: Contract-Aware Auditing of Validators for LLM-Generated GPU Kernels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15506)
*Ziyuan Li,Zihe Song,Xiaofang Qi,Wei Yang,Tao Xie*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: The effectiveness of generating GPU kernels driven by a large language model (LLM) is highly dependent on the quality of the used validator (used to accept or reject a generated kernel candidate against the contracts of the given kernel-generation task), whose results inform reward assignment, candidate selection, and speedup claims during kernel generation. However, an existing validator suffers from various limitations, e.g., wrongly accepting a candidate due to missing its forbidden library use or wrongly rejecting a candidate due to determining its permitted library use as forbidden (constraints on library uses are stated in the task contracts). To assess the quality of a validator against the given task contracts, we propose an independent-audit approach for the validator by (1) construction of audit oracle: labeling a candidate as PASS or FAIL based on three separate dimensions in our proposed contract model (i.e., semantic correctness, implementation integrity, and measurement integrity) and (2) auditing of the validator against the audit oracle: comparing the labels of the candidate against the validation results produced by the validator. For semantic correctness, reference-calibrated stress tests check output correctness on valid inputs for a candidate. For implementation integrity, reference and candidate execution traces are used to determine specific library uses. For measurement integrity, timing checks assess whether the reported runtime reflects the full time needed to complete the candidate's computation. We apply our approach to assess the quality of six validators and 716 candidates from seven corpora, including constructed controls. The evaluation results show that our approach helps assess the existing six validators to have nontrivial false-reject rates. There is high-degree agreement between the candidate labels produced by our audit oracle and human judgments.

### [432] [Git2KG: Mining socio-technical relationships in GitHub repositories as temporal knowledge graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15509)
*Lennart Hessenauer,Lisi Qarkaxhija,Ingo Scholtes*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: The widespread use of Git and GitHub in open source software (OSS) projects has produced large volumes of data on collaborative software development. Existing approaches to mine those data often use graph models to (i) capture communication between developers in the issue tracker, or (ii) represent developer-developer co-authorship or developer-file code ownership networks from the editing history of code artifacts. Integrating these data in a single knowledge graph (KG) is complicated by the need to disambiguate authors and match entities from multiple sources. Moreover, most works using network analysis have taken a time-aggregated perspective that neglects temporal dynamics of collaborations. To address these issues, we present Git2KG, an extensible Python library that mines temporal knowledge graphs (TKGs) from GitHub repositories. Git2KG extracts fine-grained co-editing relations and code ownership from the Git log. It further disambiguates developer identities to align the resulting graphs with management and communication networks extracted from GitHub issue trackers. Git2KG supports temporal analysis by slicing development events into fixed-size, non-overlapping time windows, yielding a series of knowledge graph snapshots per repository. It further supports computing node features and labels for downstream machine learning tasks. Snapshots can then be exported to PyTorch Geometric, PathPyG, and NetworkX for temporal network analysis, visualization, and graph learning.

### [433] [DafnyCert: Certifying Specification Strength in Dafny](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15548)
*Álvaro Silva,Isabel Amaral,Ruben Martins,Alexandra Mendes*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Formally verifying a method with Dafny guarantees correctness relative to its specification. However, a specification may be too permissive, allowing multiple outputs for the same input, even when the implementation produces only one. In this paper, we propose checkable certificates that provide independently verifiable evidence of whether a specification is weak or strong. A certificate of weakness contains an alternative implementation that verifies against the original specification, together with a witness input on which the original and alternative implementations produce different results. A certificate of strength is produced by constructing a harness around the original method such that successfully verifying the harness guarantees that the specification allows at most one possible output for any given input. We present DafnyCert, a tool that automatically produces these certificates. Strength is established by constructing and verifying the harness. Weakness is demonstrated by using the MutDafny mutation tool to find mutants that verify against the original specification, and by using the Hypothesis property-based testing framework to generate inputs that produce different outputs for the original program and the mutant. The resulting mutant and witness form a recheckable certificate of weakness. On a dataset of 3,910 verified Dafny methods from Dafny-Synthesis and VeriEquivBench, DafnyCert automatically certifies 3,570 methods (91.3%). We also provide certificates for the remaining 340 methods. To our knowledge, this is the first dataset in which every specification is backed by a checkable certificate of strength or weakness. These labels disagree with the benchmarks' original labels for 16.3% of the methods. These findings highlight the importance of supporting specification strength labels with independently checkable evidence.

### [434] [Does Confusing Code Confuse LLMs? A Pilot Study on C++](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15575)
*Tim van de Wetering,Lola Solovyeva,Fernando Castor*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for software maintenance tasks that depend heavily on code comprehension. While atoms of confusion, minimal code patterns empirically shown to impair human program comprehension, are well studied, it remains unclear whether these same patterns affect LLMs, and whether their impact varies across maintenance tasks. We present a pilot study evaluating the impact of atoms of confusion on LLM performance on C++ code drawn from three production libraries, using ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot on three software development tasks: atom injection and removal, output prediction, and code explanation. Our results reveal three preliminary findings: (i) the impact of atoms on LLMs is strongly task-dependent; (ii) atoms requiring reasoning about surrounding code are the most resistant to transformation, while localized syntactic atoms are handled reliably; and (iii) LLMs remove atoms of confusion more reliably than they inject them, suggesting that removal succeeds through pattern matching while injection requires deeper comprehension.

### [435] [Early Reflections on How Large Language Models are Reshaping Software Engineering Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15797)
*David Williams,Michail Kyrkos,Max Hort,Maria Kechagia,Justyna Petke,Federica Sarro*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Large language models (LLMs) are radically reshaping software engineering (SE) research. Yet, their steep financial and computational costs raise questions about who participates in that change, and who does not. By analysing all 1,918 papers published in the ICSE 2019-2026 Research and SEIP tracks, we uncover a shifting and highly concentrated research landscape. China and the US dominate LLM-based SE research, appearing in 74% of LLM-based publications between 2023-2026, yet they diverge sharply in their use of commercial versus open-weight models. Beneath this national dominance lies extreme institutional concentration: just 5 institutions in China and 7 in the US appear in more than half of their respective nations' LLM-based output. In the US, only half of the unique institutions active in 2023-2026 participated in LLM-based research, whereas Singapore displays broader usage, with 11 of 15 active institutions participating in LLM-based work. Furthermore, across 2023-2026 Research-track papers, industry involvement is more prevalent in LLM-based work (23.4% vs 16.9%), and academia-only papers make up a smaller share (63.4% vs 70.9%). Crucially, we expose a gap in model usage across industry and academia. SEIP track papers lean strongly towards commercial LLMs, with 77.4% featuring them and 40.5% using them exclusively. In contrast, only 21.2% of Research-track work relies strictly on commercial models, making greater use of open-weight models that typically support more sustainable and reproducible experiments. However, this divide warrants reflection on the extent to which SE research aligns with industry practice.

### [436] [Robo-SWE: An Executable Issue-Resolution Dataset Mined from Robot Software Repositories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16116)
*Vahid Haratian,Vahid Ansari,Mohammadhossein Malmir,Alois Knoll*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Coding agents are evaluated mostly on general-purpose software, but domain-specific systems require domain-aware evaluation. Robot software is a particularly challenging case: Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2) packages have their own build tools, simulators and learning frameworks are built on physics engines, and behavior that depends on timing and hardware is hard to test. We present Robo-SWE, a dataset of 236 executable issue-resolution tasks mined from merged pull requests in 28 public robotics repositories in four domains: ROS 2 systems, simulation and physics engines, robotics algorithm libraries, and robot-learning frameworks. Each task contains the original issue text, a container recipe for the repository at the commit before the fix, the developers' fix, and the developers' tests, which fail before the fix and pass after it in repeated offline runs. The dataset also keeps a provenance ledger of all 1,567 candidate pull requests, with the stage each reached and the reason for every rejection, and, as a first use, 3,540 graded attempts by five coding-agent setups with recorded patches and 3,529 available trajectories. Across three runs per primary setup, resolve rates range from 45.8% for Claude Sonnet 5.5 to 56.5% for Claude Opus 5.5; GPT-6.1 Sol reaches 54.1% at maximum effort and 52.5% at medium effort, and GPT-6 Astra 51.4%. GLM-5.3 resolves 46.2%, and Kimi K3.1 Pro 43.9%. The tasks are validated by execution; verification of their fairness by human reviewers is future work. The dataset and public leaderboard are available online.

### [437] [Rasoi: Visual Diffs for Evaluating Structural Changes Made by Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16293)
*Riya Sahni,Aryan Kaul,Anushka Bhatnagar,Xuanming Zhang,Vivian Liu,Reya Vir,Lydia B. Chilton*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Coding agents let developers modify software rapidly through natural language. However, as agents take on larger changes, developers can lose track of how the codebase is evolving. These edits may look correct on the surface while restructuring the system in unexpected ways: duplicating logic, changing modules outside the requested scope, removing functionality developers meant to keep, or introducing architectural drift. We investigate how visual diffs can help developers understand and evaluate the structural changes that coding agents make. We present Rasoi, a design probe that maps how a codebase's architecture evolves after each agent-made edit, letting developers inspect which architectural elements and relationships were added, modified, or removed across multiple levels of abstraction. We deployed Rasoi in a week-long study with 12 developers working on their own codebases across varied technical domains. We found that visual diffs helped developers see whether changes stayed within scope, notice unexpected restructuring, and understand how modified parts related to the system as a whole. Our findings suggest that the value of oversight tools for coding agents lies less in making developers trust the agent and more in helping developers feel confident in their own evaluation of agent-made changes. We discuss implications for visual tools that support code comprehension and human oversight in AI-assisted software development.

### [438] [Non-Functional Requirements to Hyperparameter Translation for Quantum Software via LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16902)
*Joseph G. Bronyah,Nasir U. Eisty*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Quantum software engineering (QSE) lacks validated approaches for translating natural-language non-functional requirements (NFRs) into execution parameters such as shots and transpiler optimization levels. Existing methods emphasize semantic similarity rather than execution outcomes. We evaluate seven large language models (LLMs) against a deterministic heuristic baseline using 540 synthetic and 18 real-world user stories. We assess semantic accuracy and execution outcomes, including time, cost, top-state probability, and two-qubit gate exposure, through Qiskit/Aer simulations. All LLMs significantly outperformed the heuristic in semantic accuracy, achieving 55.6 to 83.3 percent on real-world stories compared to 16.7 percent for the heuristic. However, no LLM demonstrated statistically significant superiority over others on the real-world dataset. Speed- and cost-oriented configurations reduced execution time and cost, but fidelity improvements were not supported. Some failures resulted from provider safety refusals rather than translation errors. Our findings demonstrate the potential of LLMs as middleware for NFR-to-configuration translation in QSE, while emphasizing execution-based validation, human oversight, and careful interpretation of model differences.

### [439] [Patterns for Designing CI/CD Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17276)
*Leandro Sousa,Filipe Correia*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: CI/CD pipelines are difficult to build and maintain, and information about them is scattered across empirical studies, practitioner books, and catalogues of 'smells'. We collected candidate practices and anti-practices converted them into patterns, and then consolidated these into patterns. These patterns address issues such as security, pipeline scheduling, workflow structure, performance and failure and release management. Each pattern is contextualised and describes the problem it solves, the forces at play, the solution and the consequences.

### [440] [Where LLM Agents Get Stuck Debugging Databases: Access More Than Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17304)
*Gustavo Pinto*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Large language model (LLM) coding agents are increasingly asked not only to write code but to debug running systems from live runtime data. We report a field observation of one such agent (Claude Code) as it diagnosed eight database incidents in a production message-dispatch engine. In every incident whose root cause depended on runtime concurrency, the agent announced a cause, shipped a fix, and later walked it back, and each wrong guess cost a deploy-and-observe cycle. Mapping each incident to what the agent lacked, we find that access to production state was the most pervasive bottleneck. The missing access included live lock views, untruncated deadlock reports, read-only execution, and an explicit environment context. An access gap was present in all five concurrency-dependent incidents: alone in one, and in four combined with a reasoning error such as anchoring on an early cause, incomplete exploration of the configuration, or a misreading of the code's transaction semantics. The three incidents that did not depend on concurrency needed nothing beyond what the agent already had. Within the incidents, the agent's wrong hypotheses were consistent with the evidence it could see; they were not fabrications. We argue that the next step for production-debugging agents is a forensics layer that gives the agent the access it lacks inside existing security controls. Such a layer would combine a safe interrogation API, a lock-and-deadlock flight recorder, and a production replay harness.

### [441] [SynthCorp: A Platform for Creating Benchmarks for Data Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14765)
*Jiani Zhang,Manav Garg,Eugenie Lai,Cheng Zhen,Eva Sharma,Yang Pan,Yaming Lin,Alon Halevy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SynthCorp 是 Google 提出的一个可定制的数据智能体（data agent）基准生成平台。其核心思路是：不再直接生成最终数据库快照，而是按业务事件在时间上"演化"出完整的企业数据资产（关系库 + 文档库 + 数据目录），并同步记录完整溯源日志，从而自动产出可执行、可验证的"黄金程序"任务。首批生成 7 个数据资产（最大 1K 运营表）与 256 个任务（覆盖 5 个领域），确定性管线检查错误率近零；在 3 个模型 × 4 种数据上下文设置下评测，基准能有效区分模型层级与上下文条件，并暴露出前沿智能体在多事件复合任务上的时点推理缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 驱动的企业级数据智能体需要贴近真实企业数据资产（数千张表 + 政策备忘录 + 不完整元数据目录）的基准，但学界现有基准存在三个致命限制：(1) 提供固定的数据库与静态任务集，模型很快饱和，且无法定制去测试特定能力（如从冗余副本中挑权威表、过滤低质记录、解析领域业务术语）；(2) 只能从"静态快照"起步，不记录数据"如何/为何"变成今天的样子——而真实分析题的难度恰恰来自这段历史（哪张表在迁移中替换了废弃表、新会计政策何时生效），标注者只看最终快照只能凭想象出题并逆向推导参考答案，缓慢且易错；(3) 直接生成最终快照的方法必须同时协调所有跨资产约束，schema 一大就崩；而"给干净库注入合成噪声"的方法则是孤立污染单表/单文档，不留下解释这些异动的业务上下文，智能体无从判断该信谁。

Method: SynthCorp 采用"四阶段"流水线，用"业务事件随时间演化出数据"替代"直接生成快照"。

数据资产建模为 E = ⟨D_db, D_doc, C, L_log⟩：D_db 保留所有创建过的对象（含迁移遗留的孤立表、新增列的历史 NULL 行、物化视图）、D_doc 存放政策备忘/计划/会议纪要等唯一承载业务规则的非结构化文本、C 为可故意不完整的数据目录（含业务术语表）、L_log 记录每次操作及其理由，对被评测智能体完全隐藏。

阶段一（事件合成）：给定场景与目标复杂度维度，合成可复用的"事件类型"，区分 routine 事件（每日销售、周期审计）与 disruption 事件（schema 升级、冻结快照、修订会计政策）。每个事件类型包含参数、recurrence（一次性/周期/连续）、时序约束、以及"benchmark hints"（以业务语言说明分析师需要知道的规则）。时序约束采用 Allen 区间代数的 7 个谓词（precedes/meets/within/overlaps/starts/finishes/equals）构成简单时态网络(STN)。此阶段保证三点：domain fit（每个目标维度都由某个 disruption 事件注入）、coherence（防重叠矛盾、防孤立 disruption、防时序环）、以及用户人工在环（HITL）审批（含澄清提问）。

阶段二（编译）：每个事件类型编译为在 12 个 simulation primitives (SPs) 上的程序，SPs 分四类——generative（CreateSchema/GenDocument/CreateDistribution/GenValue/HoldConversation）、stochastic（Sample）、artifact（ApplyTransactions/Query/AlterSchema/ReadDocuments）、control（Loop/Schedule）。每个 primitive 只做一个有界操作并显式声明输入/输出操作数，这定义了人写规格与 LLM 执行之间的"信任边界"；编译器静态校验跨事件一致性（共享符号表）、参照完整性（外键不得用 GenValue/独立分布）、一事件类型一程序（实例值用运行时占位符 + 日期化输出名）、程序合法性（先定义后使用、签名匹配、引用存在）。校验失败则跑一次 LLM 修复。

阶段三（调度与执行）：LLM 提议每个事件实例的起止时间，再用 STN solver 投影到可行区间（越界则钳制并更新剩余约束）；类型级约束被映射到实例序列的首末边界。执行引擎按时间序跑 SP 程序，维护虚拟时钟，更新目录（CreateSchema/Query 注册表与视图、AlterSchema 注册迁移前快照、GenDocument 抽取业务术语条目），并把 event type 的 benchmark hints 绑定到具体的表/列/文档上。

阶段四（基准生成）：用 hints + 对 L_log 与 E 的确定性检测器（9 类结构复杂度模式）+ LLM 检测器（跨文档/库矛盾等）产出原子任务，经三重"可答性"检查（复杂度须有可观测证据、问题不得暴露物理表名列名、gold 程序须干净执行且返回非空）；黄金程序由多智能体辩论生成（多模型 proposer 写 SQL 并逐条核对日志谱系与政策文档，critic 引用日志事件挑战具体子句，judge 裁决，最多 5 轮，连续两轮高置信一致即收敛），再经"溯源审计"四准则核验（与写入史一致、只读权威表、过滤度量匹配日志规则、对冻结副本插入行不改变答案）；原子任务产生可复用的 verified query fragments，再组合成复合任务（并做片段消融确认每个复杂度都影响输出）。此外还有 well-formed 与 no schema leakage 两项确定性任务有效性检查。

Result: (1) 规模与效率：7 个数据资产、256 个任务、5 个领域（零售 10/100/1000 表、音乐、银行、物流、保险），共 1,176 张基表、1,562 篇文档（228 个模板）、2,035 条术语；Retail-1000 含 1.4K 表、150 万行、15.7K 次算子调用，编译 353 分钟、执行 341 分钟。

(2) 管线正确性：14 类错误中 9 类由确定性规则引擎检查、5 类由 Claude Opus 5.5 评审。六个较小资产的九项确定性检查全部通过；Retail-1000 静态程序与日历检查全过，仅 0.2% 运行时查询失败（源于刷新查询读空上游表并级联）。语义错误主要出现在编译期：约 1.7% 的取值算子把随机抽样替换为常量，算子契约违规率 3.6%（小资产）~7.1%（Retail-1000），跨列/跨行依赖违规为 6.2%（小资产）~12.7%（全部）。作者强调这些语义错误不影响参考答案，因为 gold 程序在物化库上执行并被日志审计。

(3) 复杂度与判别力：80.1% 任务需 SQL + 文档/目录证据，39.5% 为多复杂度复合任务，91.8% 的 gold 程序语法骨架唯一（235/256），81.0% 用分组聚合、59.3% 多表 join、57.4% 嵌套子查询；68% 任务上权威表与备份/快照/副本共存，64% 任务需辨别被文档或术语表"覆盖"的过时陈述；63% 文档依赖任务所需事实集中于单篇文档，33% 需跨文档。

(4) 模型评测：Opus 4 5.5 > DeepSeek V4.1 Flash > Gemma 4 26B-A4B 在全部四种设置下一致；仅 schema 的 S1 会系统性失败（Opus 54.6%），加一篇 BM25 检索文档的 S2 提升 9~17 个百分点（最廉价的增益），多步 agentic 搜索 S3 再加 12~20 点（Opus 达 86.6%），S4 文件+CLI 与 S3 准确率相近但每正确答案 token 成本为 2.2~2.6 倍。S4 中 56%（Opus）/61%（DeepSeek）失败仅源于输出格式差异，若宽容格式判定则分别升至 94%/90%；三个全模型失败的任务中 54 次失败里有 53 次算出的是正确数字，仅格式不符，反向印证了 gold 程序的正确性。

(5) 溯源验证与难度：日志可追溯到具体业务事件，据此可修正歧义问题、纠正错误的候选 gold 程序。Retail-1000 的"各市场区运营摘要"复合任务中，候选 gold 程序读当前 loyalty_members.tier_id（880 位 Bronze），而日志中 8 月 26 日的重新分层事件（成员 802 降为 Bronze）表明正确做法应按目标日做 snap_dim_customer_history 的时点 join（826 位）；Opus 12 次运行全部犯同一错误——即使历史快照表出现在其工具输出中也从未查询。DeepSeek 同样 12 次全错。Retail-1000 的 11 个多规则复合任务上，S3 准确率从 Opus 的 91% 降至 DeepSeek 76%、Gemma 33%。

(6) 数据真实性：Banking 与真实 BIRD financial 的周末占比、金额尾部分布、交易码混合（TVD 0.37~0.45）等接近但存在可解释偏差（2026 式码本、工资事件读取滞后账户表）；在 7 个资产上检验的五类风格化事实中，人为价格尾数、核算恒等式、账户日余额链等多能复现，未被提示的周内季节性与客户集中度则偏离真实参考。

Conclusion: SynthCorp 证明"通过模拟业务事件来生成数据资产与基准"是一条可行且可扩展的路径：它把基准开发从"标注者凭空出题"转变为"从可审计的事件历史中抽取问题与答案"，从而实现可定制（按领域/规模/复杂度维度）、可再生（分钟到小时级重建，抵抗模型饱和）、可判别（区分模型层级与数据上下文）、可验证（用日志自动审计 gold 程序，无需人工标注）。作者坦承当前局限：多数生成任务对前沿模型仍偏简单、语义编译错误与分布真实性不足（面向元数据级复杂度的定位使行级数值分布次要）、并存在由空表级联引发的运行时失败；未来工作包括为跨列/跨行依赖加编译器护栏、扩充复杂度库、合成更长事件链与更深的时点状态变化、用智能体失败模式反向引导任务合成，乃至把模拟用于智能体训练奖励与"LLM 充当企业员工驱动业务事件"。论文以开放平台的形式呼吁社区共同生成更具挑战性的企业级数据智能体基准。

Abstract: Current benchmarks for LLM-driven data agents saturate quickly and cannot target specific capabilities. We present SynthCorp, a platform that creates customizable data estates and benchmarks by simulating how business events produce and modify corporate data over time. Each data estate combines relational databases, a document store, and a data catalog, paired with evaluation tasks and executable gold programs. First, given a scenario and target complexity dimensions, SynthCorp synthesizes reusable event types and compiles each into a program over predefined simulation primitives. Second, SynthCorp schedules event instances on a virtual calendar, interleaving routine and disruption events so that tables, documents, and catalog entries remain consistent. Third, SynthCorp executes the calendar to materialize the data estate and records every operation in a simulation log. Fourth, SynthCorp generates analytical tasks and derives verified gold programs from the log. We use SynthCorp to generate initial evaluation benchmarks comprising seven data estates (up to 1K operational tables) and 256 tasks across five domains. The data estates pass deterministic pipeline checks (such as foreign-key violations, undeclared writes, recurrence violations, and database execution failures) with a near-zero error rate, introduce cross-asset complexities, and cover all requested dimensions. Evaluating three models across four data-context settings shows that the benchmarks separate data contexts and model tiers. Auditing candidate queries against causal provenance in the simulation log verifies gold programs without manual annotation, including on multi-event composite tasks that expose reasoning failures in state-of-the-art agents. We hope the community uses SynthCorp to generate more challenging and useful data estates and benchmarks that foster the development of enterprise data agents.

</details>


### [442] [Zugwise: Domain-Aware Game Reconstruction for Digitizing Handwritten Chess Scoresheets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14544)
*Gerhard Trippen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Zugwise 将手写国际象棋棋谱数字化从"手写识别+合法性校验"问题重新定义为"棋局重建"（game reconstruction）问题：关键危害不是产生非法着法的"响亮"错误，而是产生合法但错误着法的"静默"错误及其导致的级联污染。系统借用计算机国际象棋引擎机制（静态搜索、静态交换评估、针检测）实现"位置荒谬检测器"，用 Needleman–Wunsch 对齐融合双方棋谱，并引入 CTC 重打分与 Maia 式人类着法先验两个学习信号。全部在浏览器端离线运行（Pyodide + ONNX Runtime Web），免费、私密。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究把棋谱数字化当作手写识别问题：分割格子、识别文本、检查合法性，最佳系统已达约 95% 自主识别率、98–99% 半自主识别率。但这一框架漏掉了最重要的错误：若识别错误恰好构成一个合法着法，合法性检查无法察觉，系统会沿错误局面继续推进并解读后续所有着法，形成"级联污染"（cascading corruption，Horváth & Dreher 2020 已独立发现并因此放弃迭代棋局状态跟踪）。这类"静默错误"能通过全部字符级、置信度与合法性筛选，在 99% 单步准确率下 80 ply 的棋局几乎必然含一个错误，且档案中无任何标记提示哪些棋局不可信。此外论文强调：MRA 这一指标已饱和，其上方的真正问题是游戏级正确性；且"每格棋谱都无误"并不等于"棋局正确"，因此需要面向棋局整体的评价与评测协议。

Method: 1) 管线：照片/扫描→网格检测（slide method：锚定印刷走子编号列，用印刷数字孔洞做滑动窗口对齐行号；逐格小透视校正；印刷竖线的"裁剪而非擦除"策略）→BiLSTM+CTC（基于 Eicher 等架构与 HCS 数据集重训，HCS 留出写作者原始识别率 82.9%，真实俱乐部棋谱 84.0%）→重建层→人机协同核验→PGN 导出。
2) 重建层核心：荒谬检测器——第 1 层为带针感知的即时攻防计数（99% 局面不触发），第 2 层为静默搜索（α-β、走子/将军/升变，深度至多 8 ply，判定"白白送吃"是否净赚 ≥2 分）以区分陷阱、针与牺牲；停止规则含坏交易（SEE）、子力被白吃、持续荒谬、带将军的免费吃子、强制将死惩罚。
3) 评分设计规则：候选排序排除"棋质"信号；手工国际象棋信号只允许经战术搜索验证的"合理性下限"证据；学习信号须满足准入标准（在预先固定的参数下须在未用于选参的棋局上提升排序，并报告对"真实记录 blunder"的影响）。综合得分 S = S_hand + λ_OCR(ℓ_OCR − c) + λ_prior(r_prior − a)，λ_OCR=3，λ_prior=10。
4) 两个学习信号：CTC 强制对齐重打分（对识别器原始逐帧对数概率做 Viterbi 最佳对齐分，缓存为 float16 sidecar 约 3.5KB/格）；自训练的人类着法先验（Maia 风格，8 残差块 128 滤波、2.4M 参数，lichess 12 万局 1900–2300 段约 835 万局面，输出 4096 个 from–to 索引并在合法着法上重归一化）。
5) 修复搜索：Quick Fixes → Phase 1（从确认前沿到卡住 ply 逐格回溯，含"幽灵将军/重复兵着/路径受阻/低置信"等证据驱动的窗口扩展）→ Phase 2（越过前沿回溯，默认 5 ply）→ Phase 3（按将军几何反推）；并支持插入（漏记）候选；reach 非对称奖励（5 ply 后封顶，整局走通保留全额）；"必须越过原卡住点"的强惩罚；三种算法 greedy/beam/Dijkstra（成本 = 21 + regret，路径至多 15 处修复）。
6) 双谱合并：用 OCR 候选池重叠度替换氨基酸替换矩阵的 Needleman–Wunsch 对齐，分 Tier 1/2/3，Tier 3 及之后一律停下交人；复核停止点（review stops）复查已确认前缀并把两张谱的合法读法分歧全部提交操作者。
7) 评测方法学：三方裁定协议——Zugwise 人工核验输出 vs 独立专家手工誊写，再逐个分歧对照原始棋谱裁定；oracle 回放框架测"可达性与排序"而非自主恢复。

Result: • 专家对比（45 局完整循环赛，1678–2167 分）：34 局逐着完全一致；13 个替换 ply 中专家正确 7、Zugwise 正确 6；27 个单侧 ply 全部来自专家记录（多为残局烂尾的取舍判断，其中 9.3 局内含整整一回合的漏记）。裁定后 Zugwise 41/45、专家 37/45（不计残局尾部则 40/45）无已识别错误；两方在分歧处错在不同的 ply，无一处双方同错。
• 复核停止点效果（oracle 回放）：静默错误 16→1（第一赛区）、50→13（第二赛区）、11→1（Open 赛区）；终局残留错误着法 10→3、11→6、9→2；代价是每局约多 7 次确认。
• 学习信号（1,290 个替换决策）：仅手工信号 top-1 为 58.8%；加 CTC 69.9%；加先验 71.6%；两者同加 78.0%（top-3 93.8%）；低相似度子集由 29% 升至 65%；先验单独仅 43.2%，但低相似度子集优于手工信号。第二赛区（权重冻结）57.7%→69.1%；Open 赛区两者同达 80.6%，增益在游戏级符号检验 p<10⁻⁵~10⁻⁸ 显著，且对已正确记录的 blunder 的 top-3 保留率未下降。
• 消融：关闭荒谬检测后 33 个错误中 24 个（73%）只在中位 2 ply 之后才浮现、4 个永不被标记；关闭 Phase 2 使候选表外修正从 2 增至 7；字符混淆模型与两个免费吃子惩罚在 8 局语料上近乎中性。
• 引擎评估（Stockfish 19）：交叉验证内有 +1.4~+1.7 点增益，但在预注册的新赛段上仅 +0.8~+1.0 点且 95% 区间含 0，未获确认，因而未上线；其损失集中在玩家真实失误处（>300cp 损失时引擎项净输 14 胜 1）。
• 仅合法性基线：同一 OCR 输入下，自治协议 8 局全部重建失败（单局准确率 2%–95%），理想化半自治协议仅重建 3/8，另 5 局首个静默错误出现在 ply 7–48 之后。
• 局限：未证明任一工作流更快或更准；操作者即作者兼裁定者；一致着法未独立审计；仅支持英文 SAN（意大利记谱 R=王 会与英式车混淆）；候选表外正确着法需人工补入。

Conclusion: 手写棋谱数字化的本质不是"识别+合法性后处理"，而是"棋局重建"：应恢复的对象是棋局本身，棋谱只是关于它的噪声证据。因此评价应从 MRA 转向游戏级正确性，且需承认"合法≠正确"，评测应采用无人可充当 ground truth 领域里的三方裁定协议。方法上，可把引擎的战术机制从"这步该走什么"改用于"人是否会这样写"，并用检测与修复分离的层级架构（荒谬检测定位错误点 + 前沿回溯追根因 + 复核停止点）把静默错误变为响亮错误；候选排序应排除关于局面"好坏"的手工判断，只容纳经战术验证的合理性证据与从人群学到的"人类会怎么走"的测量型先验。合理性的边界必须由局面之外的上下文（续着、棋谱终点、笔迹）来划定，这正是系统保留人工环节的理由，也决定了系统的目标是把操作者的问题减到少而精、而非消除人工。工程上，整套流程可在浏览器内离线运行，免费、私密、零边际成本，从而使"整场赛事的手写棋谱档案化"从不可能变为可行。

Abstract: Digitizing handwritten chess scoresheets has been studied as a handwriting-recognition problem: read the move in each box and check that it is legal. This framing misses the errors that matter most. A misread that yields an illegal move is loud. One that yields a legal-but-wrong move is silent, because a legality-only pipeline accepts it and reads every later move against a wrong position. We therefore treat the task as game reconstruction and present Zugwise, which repurposes computer-chess machinery (quiescence search, static exchange evaluation, pin detection) to ask not "what should be played?" but "could a human plausibly have written this?" An absurdity detector makes silent errors loud at or near where they occur, and a backward search traces late symptoms to their cause. Candidate ranking excludes chess-quality signals. A Needleman-Wunsch merge adds the second player's sheet as evidence, and review stops send every disagreement between the sheets' legal readings to a human. In oracle replay of two tournament sections, a release adding them cuts silent errors from 16 to 1 and from 50 to 13. Two learned signals, CTC re-scoring against the recognizer's raw output and a Maia-style human-move prior, raise the correct fix's top-rank rate from 58.8% to 78.0% of the replacement decisions where it is a candidate, and hold without refitting on a later section. On the first section, the human-verified output matches an independent expert transcription move for move on 34 of 45 games, and adjudication against the sheets found errors in both records, on different plies. We do not establish that either workflow is faster or more accurate. The system runs entirely in the browser and is free, private, and offline-capable; alongside it we offer a three-way adjudication protocol for a domain where no single record is ground truth.

</details>


### [443] [Cleaning an Agent's History Hurts When the World Still Holds the Error](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14654)
*Egor Pakhomov,Anurag Koul,Hongjun Liu,Bo Pang,Shafiq Joty,Erik Nijkamp*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文指出：清理/压缩/交接代理历史时，"记录说了什么"与"世界实际处于什么状态"必须分开评估。同一正确值，在固定世界下写成"如实附注"可使恢复率从51%升到66%，写成"代理自己已完成的动作"却使恢复率从50%降到44%（比不编辑更差），两者差22个百分点；在固定记录下，成功回执在效果缺失时使整任务成功率从45%降到28%，在效果存在时从38%升到49%，交互作用达27个百分点。结论是：历史编辑的效果取决于它所描述的世界，形式上"干净"的记录若对应仍含错误的世界，可能比完全不编辑更糟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具型 LLM 代理会累积包含自身错误的历史；上下文压缩、失败步骤修复、跨代理交接等系统都在"清洗"这份记录（record），而删除或改写记录并不会撤销世界中已发生的后果。先前研究都在"记录与世界同时改动"或"世界固定但记录改写同时伴随'已完成'断言"的情形下工作，因此无法区分性能变化究竟来自记录所披露的正确答案，还是来自记录所断言的"该步骤已完成"。本文提出核心问题：同一份正确内容，在不同的表述方式（用户附注 vs 代理自身已完成动作）和不同的世界状态（效果存在 vs 缺失）下，究竟是有益还是有害？并指出 AgentCE-Bench 中 1350 个源片段里有 393 个出现了"回执确认成功但世界仍是错值"的自发记录—世界不一致，说明该问题并非人为构造。

Method: 两项受控设计，均采用"冻结—编辑—精确恢复—续写—打分"流程，可在同一冻结状态上反复比较。
(1) AgentCE-Bench 四臂设计：319 个任务中途冻结状态（代理已把错值写入持久状态），四臂为 O（原始记录）、F（伪造成代理自身已完成动作、断言写入正确值而世界仍是错值）、T（在保留错误旁追加一条如实说明错误与正确值的用户角色附注）、N（在角色、位置、轮数、cl100k token 数上匹配的"中性"空附注）。主估计量 D=(T−N)−(F−O)，10,000 次任务簇 bootstrap，95% 区间。回收率（recovery）= 续写结束时前视目标槽位中持有正确值的比例，按真值评分而非 LLM 裁判。
(2) AppWorld 记录×世界交叉设计：源片段在首次成功的数据库写入处冻结（focal step），记录因子（回执断言成功 succ / 失败 fail，失败回执为固定字符串且含"未修改任何数据"字样）× 世界因子（数据库处于写入前 pre / 写入后 post），每个世界中恰有一个回执为真；估计交互 I=(succ_post−fail_post)−(succ_pre−fail_pre)，按任务族 bootstrap，交互在 97.5% 水平读取（两个确证性主量的预留水平）。65 个任务族 × 8 个接收模型（gpt-5.5、claude-sonnet-5、gpt-5/5-mini、gpt-4o、gpt-4o-mini、gemini-3.1-pro-preview、grok-4.6），1,040 次续写，30 步预算。
另有针对性控制（同基准九臂：假成功断言 × 世界修复，考察"具体性"）、通道分解（仅报错旗标 / 仅给答案 / 完整附注）、AgentCE-Bench 上的记录×世界析因、AppWorld 追加附注三次独立采集。接收模型难度校准至 25–75% 成功带；恢复机制经 replay 认证（AgentCE-Bench 200/200、AppWorld 20/20）；所有分数由零模型调用脚本重算。

Result: AgentCE-Bench（319 状态、638 块、2,552 次续写、gpt-5.5 与 claude-sonnet-5）：T−N=+15.20pp [12.46, 18.00]，F−O=−6.43pp [−8.88, −3.97]，预写主量 D=+21.63pp [18.21, 25.08]，两个接收模型均为正；T−O=+15.65pp、F−N=−6.87pp，换用对照不改变结论；中性附注 N−O=+0.44pp [−1.36, 2.32] 未决。增益具局部性：+11.57pp 落在附注点名的槽位，其余前视槽位 +3.63pp；47 个错误不在前视目标内的状态上 T−N 未决且两个模型符号相反（claude −10.64pp、gpt-5.5 +7.78pp）。"答案存在即可复制"的解释被证伪：F 把正确答案放在代理自身调用中却落后于原始记录，说明决定因素不是内容在场。通道分解显示仅标出错误而不给替换值无显著帮助（+1.62pp 未决），仅给正确值可达 +11.70pp，完整附注 +16.46pp。
AppWorld（1,040 次续写）：交互 I=+27.31pp [14.23, 41.54]（97.5%），成功回执在效果缺失时 −16.92pp [−24.62, −9.62]，在效果存在时 +10.38pp [3.46, 17.69]；两个记录—世界一致的格仅差 3.47pp。逐模型看：97.5% 水平 8 个中有 6 个为正，95% 水平 7 个为正，gpt-4o-mini 未决（+2.38pp [−6.35, 11.11]）；gpt-4o 为后补的跟随验证（在同族 63 框架下 +61.90pp），说明"世代"不是解释。过程诊断显示：效果存在时成功回执使重复发出同一请求的比例从 52.69% 降到 10.38%；40 个插入行的族中假失败回执导致 claude-sonnet-5 有 51.25% 的续写重复写入该行（真回执下仅 3.75%），说明失败回执的"无数据变更"字样本身是竞争解释。针对性控制的具体性为 +4.628pp [2.989, 6.317]（97.5%），规则掉了"接收模型被直接喂了答案"的强解释，但"记录标示了剩余工作位置"的弱解释仍成立（且采集不完整、3pp 门槛未过、依赖单一焦点槽）。AgentCE-Bench 上直接做记录×世界析因只得到 +3.90pp [0.56, 7.18]，未过其自设 3pp 门槛。

Conclusion: 记录与其所描述的世界是耦合的：历史编辑的效应既取决于编辑如何陈述内容，也取决于世界实际持有什么。在固定世界下，把正确值记为"如实附注"提升恢复率，而记为"代理自身已完成的动作"使其低于不编辑的基线；在固定记录下，成功回执的效应随数据库状态翻转符号。因此压缩、修复或交接策略不能只按"记录看起来是否干净"来判断，必须针对世界来评测；由于环境可精确恢复，这类策略可在部署前于选定冻结状态上按任务指标打分。论文也坦陈局限：真相与信道（用户附注 vs 自身动作）未做正交交叉、AppWorld 两种回执内容本身不同、AgentCE-Bench 上步数预算不均且各臂耗尽率不同、承载主结果的接收模型太少（且多数跨模型接续，差异与操作点混淆）、编辑与状态均由作者选定、增益具局部性、两个预注册分析因封存脚本与估计器无法运行而改用重实现（由第二个独立实现交叉验证）、针对性控制不完整且缺"如实"臂。下一步建议：加入假附注与"就地如实改写"两臂以分离真相与信道、用长度与内容匹配的回执、加入表面作者匹配的追加对照、第三个四臂接收模型、在不绑定预算下重跑、以及一个可完成且含如实臂的全新针对性控制。

Abstract: Tool-using language-model agents accumulate histories of their own mistakes, and a system that compacts, repairs or hands off such a history decides what it says about those mistakes while their effects stay in the world. Prior work cleans the history at a fixed world, where showing a corrected step and saying it is done move together. We ask whether the same correct content helps or hurts depending on how the history states it and what the world holds. We freeze an agent mid-task with its exact world state, edit the history or the world, and let a receiver model continue. On AgentCE-Bench, after the agent commits a wrong value, we hold the world fixed and add the correct value by two natural edits: a truthful note beside the preserved error or the agent's own completed action. The note raises recovery, the share of remaining targets the receiver gets right, from 51% under a matched neutral note to 66%. The completed action lowers it below the unedited history, from 50% to 44%, so the value's presence alone does not predict the effect. On AppWorld, after a database write, we vary whether its receipt reports success or failure and whether its effect is present. A success receipt lowers whole-task success from 45% to 28% while the effect is absent and raises it from 38% to 49% once present. The two effects differ by 27 points pooled over two receivers, a difference positive in six of eight receivers at 97.5% and seven at 95%. A history edit's effect thus depends on the world it describes, and a history made to look clean while the world still holds the error can leave an agent worse off than no edit at all.

</details>


### [444] [Together Compiler: Continual Compilation for AI Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14681)
*Reyna Abhyankar,Dylan Lim,Drew Wadsworth,Venkata Hasith Vattikuti,YuTong Julia Zhang,Jung Hwan Heo,Taeksang Kim,Kesavan Ramakrishnan,Evangelene Stanley,Xinyu Fang,Daniel Y. Fu,Simran Arora*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Together AI 提出 TKCC（Together Compiler），首个面向 AI 推理优化的"持续化（continual）"智能体闭环系统。其核心是分层持久化引擎（Tiered Persistent Engine）+ 并行配置成本模型 + 移除人类先验（"苦涩的教训"）。在 Llama 1B 上比手写 Megakernel 快 1.7×，在 InferenceX 基准上比最优开源引擎快至多 2.6×，batch size 1 下达到 1111 TPS（MiniMax M3.1 Flash）与 1205 TPS（DeepSeek v4.1 Flash），并已在生产环境每天服务数万亿 token。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Together AI 的推理流量持续变化（行为趋势差异、突发性用量增长、使用模式渐变，如 ISL 从 10K 增至 18K、缓存命中率变化），静态编译无法适应。现有智能体优化系统存在"测量吞吐 vs 测量保真度"的根本权衡：一类系统（Alibaba、Cursor）在离线基准上优化单个 kernel，随机输入导致低保真度——随机数据会多激活 13–38% 的 MoE 专家，使 Cursor 的 MoE megakernel 在真实流量下慢 6–15%；稀疏 top-k 注意力 kernel 基于随机数据写成，在真实数据上出现二次复杂度，端到端慢 1.3×。另一类系统（Apple RSI-Inference Bench、AMD、Decagon）直接做端到端引擎优化，保真度高但每次测量需重启引擎，冷启动达 761 秒（模型加载 265s、autotuning 192s、CUDA-graph 捕获 192s 等），迭代速度跟不上流量变化速度，GPU 空闲浪费严重。

Method: 1) 分层持久化引擎（Tiered Persistent Engine）：将引擎启动/销毁与前向计算解耦，引擎一次性初始化后通过 hot-reload 替换 model.forward 函数指针并重新捕获 CUDA/HIP graph；建立快层（12 层，启动 3 分钟、hot-reload 17s、测量方差 0.05%）与慢层（60 层，11 分钟、45s、方差 0.14%）双测量层，快层用于筛除 IMA/挂起，慢层提供高保真信号；配合前缀缓存复用（Kimi K3 上额外 2.6×）与 kernel binary 复用、多智能体并行通信（优化速度 2.3×）、prefill/decode 分离测量（方差 6.6%→2.7%）与最少层数调优。2) 并行配置成本模型：构建 EP/TP/DP/CP 组合的搜索空间，按可整除性、显存与 TTFT/TPS SLA 剪枝；分层测量（理论规格→实测计算/内存/通信→端到端前向），用 T_pass = Σ[max(T_c, D/BW)+T_comm] 估计前向时间，取 C=min(C_memory, C_speed) 的并发度，换算为 TPM 指标；对 MoE 用 Zipf 路由分布与二项分布建模专家不均衡及 max-over-ranks 期望，对注意力按窗口/压缩/稀疏选择精确计算 query-key 对数。3) 智能体上下文"苦涩教训"消融：移除自研 IR、专家知识库（带知识库反而慢 25–31%）、专家策略（朴素 prompt 的智能体集成 6.2× 优于专家策略 4.9×）与研究日志图结构（记账占 8% 工具调用时间），仅保留引擎源码。4) 验证门禁（KV cache 污染、bit-exactness、质量检查）与成本/价值权衡的候选筛选。

Result: (1) 在 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct 上 batch size 1、ISL 32、H100/B200 上比 ThunderKittens、Mirage Persistent Kernel、VDcores 等手写 Megakernel 快至多 1.7×（约 2100 TPS）；分析发现细粒度分页收益仅 3.1%，PDL/CUDA graph/L2 预取即可替代持久化 megakernel。(2) 在 InferenceX 基准上（Kimi K3、GLM 5.3、MiniMax M3.1 Flash、DeepSeek v4.1 Flash；B200/B300/GB300/MI355X/Trainium2）24 小时内、每模型仅用 2 个节点即达至多 2.6× TPS 提升；batch size 1 下 1111 TPS（M3.1 Flash on B200）、1205 TPS（DeepSeek v4.1 Flash on GB300），其中 MiniMax 的 TP8 配置比已发布最佳（633 TPS）高 1.8×。(3) 成本模型为 Kimi K3 找到新并行配置，TPS 提升至多 24%、TPM 至多 18%。(4) 双层测量相比单慢层评估候选多 8.1×（1354 vs 168）、最终方案快 7.2%；相对 RSI-Inference Bench 智能体实验吞吐高 252×、空闲时间低 11×。(5) 跨领域：天气（AIFS-ENS 2.0 3.5×、Aurora 1.5 3.7×）、生物（Boltz-2 1.5×、Evo 2 1.6×）、时序（Chronos-2 2.6×、Panda-72M 1.9×）、PDE（Walrus 4.3×、Poseidon-T 6.4×）均优于 Claude Code，且保持 bit-exact；AIFS/Aurora 可在同墙钟时间内多采样 3 倍，降低 RMSE/CRPS。(6) 智能体时间分析：>50% 时间在等待测量门（AMD GLM-5.3 57%），吞吐仍是主要瓶颈；GPU 上 megakernel 融合收益仅 0.22%（网格同步 1.5–3.5μs vs PDL 边界 0.5–1μs），而 Trainium2 上整层融合有效。常见收益来自通信-计算融合（Lamport all-reduce、NVLS）、删除冗余操作（FlashMLA 16→64 头填充）、PDL（DeepSeek decode 固定开销 −9.7%）、Blackwell tcgen05 NVFP4、thread-block clusters、调优厂商库 tile（273→210μs）。

Conclusion: 静态推理时代已结束，推理呈"多态（polymorphic）"特征，每种工作负载都需要专门化部署。TKCC 将智能体驱动的优化从原型推进到可扩展的生产系统，其三条原则为：(1) 平衡测量吞吐-保真度权衡（分层持久化引擎）；(2) 确立上限（能推理软件实现不成熟性的成本模型）；(3) 最小化人类干预（删除自研 IR、知识库、专家策略，把决策权交给智能体）。智能体驱动优化要真正有用必须是"持续"的。未来方向包括设计不限制优化空间但可用于验证编译产物的 IR，以及突破测量门等待带来的吞吐上限。

Abstract: Today's AI workloads are rapidly changing: new models are released more often, model architectures are increasingly diverse, and traffic distributions change frequently. The challenge we face at Together AI is continual optimization for these changing workloads. Compiling a deployment into an optimized forward pass is a challenge that is well-suited for agent hill-climbing. Existing systems struggle with continual compilation due to a tradeoff between measurement throughput and fidelity. Many systems use agents to optimize individual kernels from the inference forward pass using offline benchmarks, but timings are low-fidelity because of data-dependent behavior in primitives like mixture-of-experts (MoE). On the other hand, systems use agents to directly optimize end-to-end engines but suffer from slow engine launch times. To address these challenges, we build Together Compiler (TKCC), the first truly continual agent loop designed for AI inference optimization. To address the throughput-fidelity tradeoff, we propose: (1) a Tiered Persistent Engine that decouples engine launch overheads from forward pass computation; (2) a cost model to select the parallelism configurations that seed the optimization process. We also conduct extensive ablations on agent context management and present our insights on deploying TKCC in production. TKCC outperforms highly-optimized hand-written Megakernels on the Llama 1B workhorse workload by up to 1.7x and the best open source engines on the latest frontier models (Kimi K3, GLM 5.3, MiniMax M3.1 Flash, DeepSeek v4.1 Flash) across hardware platforms by up to 2.6x higher TPS on the InferenceX benchmark. TKCC also sets the state-of-the-art performance at batch size 1, with 1111 TPS on M3.1 Flash and 1205 TPS on DeepSeek v4.1 Flash. Finally, TKCC generalizes beyond frontier language model inference. TKCC serves trillions of tokens across our production fleet.

</details>


### [445] [When Should Semantic Priors Enter Partially-Identified Causal Discovery?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14736)
*Muhammad Ahmed Mohsin,Saad Bin Ather,Valentin Six,Lancelot Da Costa,Tommaso Salvatori,Bernhard Scholkopf*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文把"LLM 语义先验何时、以何种方式进入部分可识别因果发现"拆解为三个相互独立的决策——查询分配（allocation）、提案准入（admission）与图集保留（retention）——并用严格的对照实验与有限样本证书逐层检验。核心结论：语义信息本身确实有效（相对硬币翻转定向，Directed-F1 提升 +8.3 个百分点，相对基线提升 +18.6 个百分点；三个附加网络上的语义解析相对 bootstrap 解析提升 +0.42 pp，区间 [0.24, 0.59] pp），但"把语义查询投向有限样本不稳定边（F2）"并不优于匹配随机分配（四组主设置的全部区间均含 0）；所测试的有限网格 Hoeffding 准入证书因所需独立图任务数远超现有校准池（10 个 F1、9 个 F2）而无法支撑任何非平凡准入；下游保留的保证完全受制于"参考集充分性"，而学习到的参考集仅在 80 个计划任务中的 3 个里包含真实 DAG，致使真图保留概率的上界 p_D 极低、效应覆盖下界趋于零。因此结论是：语义辅助应作为因果发现的"组件"而非统计证据的替代物，其价值与可靠性的来源必须分开评估，瓶颈在于校准规模与参考集构造，而非语义本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 观察数据下的因果发现往往只能给出等价类或方向不稳定的结果。LLM 能从变量名与描述中读出机制、时序与领域关系，从而补充观测数据缺失的方向信息；但语义建议是"可错的专家"，一次错误定向就可能把真实 DAG 排除在候选类之外，使下游干预分析、效应估计失效。作者指出，已有工作（Kıcıman et al. 2023；Ban et al. 2023；Vashishtha et al. 2023；Long et al. 2023；MosaCD；Guess2Graph；learning to defer 等）通常把"语义内容本身的价值""查询位置选得好不好""错误提案能否被安全接纳""下游是否仍保留真图"混为一谈。核心动机是：必须把这三个决策分开度量，否则"图恢复变好"会被误读为"风险被校准"、"准入风险低"会被误读为"真图被保留"。此外，作者还强调方向不确定有两种本质不同的来源：模型类下的总体不可识别（population non-identifiability）与有限样本下的统计不稳定（finite-sample instability），前者只能靠附加识别假设或语义信息打破，后者原则上可由更大样本缓解，二者对应完全不同的"语义何时该介入"的答案。

Method: 【问题设定】数据 D 服从由 DAG G* 生成的分布 P，假设因果充分性、Markov 条件与忠实性；实验使用线性高斯结构方程与不受限噪声方差；识别性相对模型类 M 定义：Θ_M(P)={θ∈M: P_θ=P}，方向在等价类上恒定即"已识别"。

【1. 查询分配】区分 F1（总体不可识别方向，对应可逆 CPDAG 边）与 F2（总体已识别但在有限样本下不可靠恢复的方向）。实际不可观测二者，故用拟合量代理：F̂1 = 拟合图的未定向边；F̂2 由 B=25 次行 bootstrap 构造，对骨架边统计两方向出现数 n_{i→j}, n_{j→i} 与未定向出现数 n_u，定义方向偏斜 q_e = max{n_{i→j},n_{j→i}}/(n_{i→j}+n_{j→i}) 与邻接支持 a_e=(n_{i→j}+n_{j→i}+n_u)/B，当 n_{i→j}+n_{j→i}>n_u 且 q_e<τ(=0.75) 时该已提交箭头进入 F̂2（另做 a_e≥m_adj 敏感性分析）。策略：F1-only、F1+F2、F1+rand（按匹配的实现响应预算随机选已提交箭头）、F1+F2-data（用 bootstrap 方向计数解析 F2 目标，用于隔离"分配"与"解析"两因素）。语义约束加入前先松弛所选已提交箭头并释放强制碰撞限制，实际存储的参考类记为 Θ̂_D。

【2. 语义提案与准入】每对变量做 R=10 次平衡展示顺序的查询，v+/v− 计有效方向票，score s_e=max{v+,v−}/R；UNKNOWN/无效输出计为弃票，主策略需≥6 票一致方形成提案。按规范无序对顺序处理候选，提案仅当累积约束仍允许有效 DAG 补全时才直接准入；超时补全检查返回"未知"、不构成认证；传播所得方向单独记账，不算额外语义观测。

【3. 准入认证】固定阈值网格 T={.5,…,1.0}，任务级损失 L_g(t)=V_g(t)/max{1,M_g(t)}，经验风险 R̂(t) 为其均；用 Hoeffding + 网格并合给出 U_H(t)=min{1, R̂(t)+sqrt(log(|T|/η)/2n)}，在满足 U_H(t)≤α 的阈值中选准入率最大者，无合格则弃权；对应独立任务数要求 n≥⌈log(|T|/η)/(2α²)⌉（正损失时改为 α−R̂(t)）。另给精确二项"零事件"上界 1−(η/|T|)^{1/n} 作为对比，并强调二者都不认证真实池上的任何非平凡策略；经验 Agreement 与 Add-one 选择器作为独立诊断报告。

【4. 误差容忍的保留】冻结打分策略，用独立校准集的真 DAG 分歧计数 V_1..V_m 与目标计数可交换，取 r=⌈(m+1)(1−δ_S)⌉、k=V_(r)（r>m 时 k=∞）；定义 D_{A'}(G)=Σ 1{d_G(e)≠d(e)}（缺边也计分歧），保留集 Θ^(k)={G∈Θ̂_D: D_{A'}(G)≤k}。定理 1：Pr(G*∈Θ^(k)) = p_D − Pr(A∩{V_new>k}) ∈ [max{0,p_D−δ_S}, p_D]，其中 p_D=Pr(G*∈Θ̂_D)；进一步对固定目标效应 θ*，若真图成员区间覆盖率达 1−δ_P 且报告包络包含所有保留成员区间，则 Pr{θ*∈I(Θ^(k))} ≥ max{0,p_D−δ_S−δ_P}；动作规则为 ℓ>0 则正、u<0 则负、否则弃权，并给出"行动且造成非正收益"的联合风险 ≤ 1−p_D+δ_S。

【理论附录】命题1（成对观察不可区分性：忠实线性高斯下可逆 CPDAG 边存在同分布、方向相反的两个 DAG，观察规则的 minimax 方向错误率至少 1/2）；命题2（顺序准入的结构可行性：若每次接受更新都保留至少一个补全，则累积约束始终可满足，但不保证真值成员或跨 MEC 的完全表示）；命题3（有限网格准入证书的证明）；命题4（低准入损失不蕴含硬保留：每个任务恰有 1 个错误且 M≥⌈1/α⌉ 次准入时损失 ≤α 但零错概率为 0）；命题5（错误位置决定效应影响：仅凭计数无法给出效应误差界，反向表示 X=b/(1+b²)Y+W 可使 X→Y 的效应为零）；命题6（行动联合伤害界）。另含松弛与传播分析：CPDAG 规则 R1 会把放松类中被允许的碰撞结构错误移除，故所有保留陈述仅针对实际存储的 Θ̂_D。

【实验设计】基准网络 Asia、Sachs、Child、Insurance、Alarm（主恢复面板）与 Barley、Hailfinder、Win95pts（附加族）；每网络 5 个配对种子，N=500/2000；线性高斯、噪声标准差 sqrt(exp(U))，U~Unif(−2,2)，父系数幅度 Unif(.5,1.2)，变量标准化。估计器：PC（causal-learn 0.1.4.8，Fisher-z 检验 α=0.05，stable-PC）与 BOSS（BIC）；单次拟合 60 秒超时。语义模型：Claude Opus 4.5（OpenRouter，主实验温度 0.8，附加族温度 0），主系统提示要求仅返回一个方向标签、不作解释，选项 A_TO_B / B_TO_A / UNKNOWN。评估：Directed-F1、SHD、pooled 与 equal-network 汇总、探索性 95% 网络区间（Δ̄ ± t_{J−1,.975}·s_Δ/√J），缺失结果保留为缺失而非零。另含语义可靠性干预面板（Named / No-Benchmark / Anonymous / Shuffled）、顺序敏感性、完成性审计、以及原生 Guess2Graph 骨架对比（非匹配预算，单列报告）。

Result: 【语义内容有效】等网络 Directed-F1：Semantic − Coin = +.08263 [.01917,.14609]，Coin − Base = +.10363 [.01250,.19476]，Semantic − Base = +.18626 [.05838,.31413]（95 个可用任务、5 个网络）。语义解析 vs bootstrap 解析：主面板 +.01718 [−.00515,.03951]；附加族 +.00418 [.00243,.00593]（+0.42 pp）；合并敏感性 +.01230 [−.00038,.02499]；附加族 SHD 对比 −.25146 [−.47082,−.03211]。语义可靠性呈现清晰的"内容 vs 熟悉度"分离：Named 1143/1280 正确、No-Benchmark 1114/1280、Anonymous 1052/1280、Shuffled 705/1280 且 538/1760 输出 UNKNOWN；80 响应上限下 Named−Shuffled 的 Directed-F1 增益为 .0360–.0999。

【分配无优势】F2 − 匹配随机：主面板 +.00474 [−.01527,.02475]；附加族 −.00104 [−.00605,.00398]；合并 +.00257 [−.00795,.01310]；四个主设置（PC-500 +.01672、PC-2000 −.01479、BOSS-500 −.00379、BOSS-2000 +.01596）全部区间含 0，且预算扫描 10/20/40/80 呈非单调。Bootstrap–LLM 同意门与传播式分配均未在各估计器制度下占优（传播为"冻结响应回放"，285 条中 25 条缺响应）。留一网络影响检查显示语义解析差值在所有设置下符号保持为正。

【准入认证不可用】真实校准池仅含 10 个 F1 与 9 个 F2 图任务，而零损失时所需 n≥⌈log(60/0.1)/(2α²)⌉（α=.1 时约 1193；精确二项对比需 39/19/12），已超过两池；且任何经验损失 R̂≥α 的阈值在有限 n 下不可被认证。故该证书无法支持非平凡准入——这是"所测证书 + 现有独立任务数"的限制，而非普适样本复杂度下界。经验选择器（Add-one、Agreement）仅作描述性报告，不继承证书。

【保留受参考充分性钳制】定理 1 给出真图保留概率上界即 p_D=Pr(G*∈Θ̂_D)，剪枝无法提高之；而学习参考集在 80 个计划任务中仅 3 个包含真实 DAG，p_D 因此极低，导致 (9)、(10) 的效应覆盖下界 max{0,p_D−δ_S−δ_P} 近乎失效；且该界是边际的，条件于真图在参考集中时只能得到 ≥max{0,1−δ_S/p_D}。命题4/5 说明即使准入损失很小，硬承诺（k=0）也可能排除真图，且方向错误计数本身不控制效应误差。

【其他诊断与局限】τ 敏感性：τ=.75 时错箭头召回 .80、已正确箭头被查率 .354，但提高 τ 至 .95 使候选增至 107、召回 .98；邻接支持敏感性显示 compelled 比例由 .511 升至 .923 时平均 Directed-F1 反由 .684 降至 .639——候选池"更干净"未必带来更好恢复。提案顺序是策略的一部分（27/95 实例结果改变，平均 ΔF1=−.0192）。原生 Guess2Graph 在骨架上略优于共享 PC 基线（N=500: ΔSkel-F1 +.0254，ΔAdj-SHD −.368；N=2000: +.0142 / −.750），但为非匹配预算对比。作者明确列出局限：基准族仅 8 个、网络区间为探索性、LLM 可能已熟悉基准、部分任务级文件与 coin 对照的重复次数/随机种子缺失、缺失数据不完整性等，故不主张 SOTA 结论。

Conclusion: 语义信息本身对部分可识别因果发现有可测量的价值（优于硬币翻转与统计基线，且优于纯 bootstrap 方向解析），但把语义查询"精准投向不稳定边"这一直觉未被实验支持——与匹配随机分配相比无既定优势，候选池特性的变化（更高 compelled 比例、更高错箭头召回）也未转化为更好的恢复。因此语义辅助应定位为因果发现的一个"组件"：与统计证据结合、优先用于真正模糊的方向、并保留对图不确定性的显式维护，而非作为统计证据的替代或自动取代。

在准入层面，低准入损失与下游真图保留是两种不同的失效模式：所测试的有限网格 Hoeffding 证书在现有独立图任务池下无法给出任何非平凡准入保证；这一结论限定于该证书与这些数据，不构成普适下界。保留层面的真正瓶颈是"参考充分性"：剪枝只能保住已存在的真图，无法找回被排除的真图；在学习参考集仅 3/80 任务含真 DAG 的现实下，任何效应包络覆盖保证都近乎空转，说明改进强参考集构造（而非放松剪枝规则）是更根本的方向。

总体而言，本文的方法论贡献在于把"语义内容、查询位置、方向解析"与"准入风险、参考充分性、下游保留"两条链条做操作化分离，并用 coin/matched-random/bootstrap-only/同意门/传播等对照与显式证书诊断，为各阶段给出独立的成功或失败判定；并指出未来工作的关键在：(i) 学习式或决策感知的查询分配，(ii) 更强的参考集构造与真图覆盖诊断，(iii) 在规模显著更大的独立图任务集合上校准准入规则，(iv) 扩展到更多因果领域与对基准不熟悉的语义模型与更完整的可复现记录。

Abstract: Observational causal discovery often leaves causal di- rections unresolved or unstable. Large language mod- els (LLMs) can provide semantic information to resolve these directions, but incorrect proposals can exclude the true causal graph and invalidate downstream inference. We study three separate decisions: where to allocate semantic queries, which proposals to admit, and which causal graphs to retain. Our framework distinguishes population non-identifiability from finite-sample insta- bility, evaluates semantic orientation against statistical and random controls, and examines calibrated admis- sion and error-tolerant DAG retention. Experiments across benchmark networks show that semantic infor- mation improves recovery over coin-flip orientations, but targeting unstable edges has no established ad- vantage over matched-random allocation. The tested admission certificate cannot support nontrivial admis- sion with the available calibration tasks. Moreover, downstream retention depends on reference adequacy: learned references contain the true DAG in only three of 80 planned tasks. These findings separate the value of semantic information from the reliability of its alloca- tion, admission, and retention, and identify calibration size and reference adequacy as key limitations.

</details>


### [446] [Rational Use of Time for Social Coordination in Humans and AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14766)
*Xiulin Yang,Sirisha Gudavalli,Jennifer Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究人类与 AI 在无显式沟通、仅有“时间流逝”这一隐式信号的情况下如何进行动态社会协调：以双人合作卡牌游戏 The Mind 为任务，评测 150 名人类、3 个计算机使用智能体（CUA）与 10 个文本提示型 LLM，与 5 类基于规则的策略对手（Linear/Bayesian ± 校准、Random）配对。核心结论：人类与前沿模型的行为都最符合“贝叶斯时间推断”策略，前沿 LLM 在成绩上可匹敌甚至超过人类；但人类能随对局进程持续适应同伴（成功率显著上升、速度加快），而模型普遍表现为“变快但变差”或“变准但变慢”的权衡，缺乏稳定的适应性；LLM 的行为还强烈依赖于提示中时间的呈现粒度，甚至可能只是数“被提示等待了多少次”而非真正推理时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有研究只表明人类能从一次性时间线索（如停顿时长）推断他人心智状态，缺少对“动态、细粒度”的时间信号如何被用于跨回合社会协调的系统解释；同时 AI 研究多聚焦显式语言符号，或把时间表示为静态时间戳/时长，未检验缺乏连续实时体验的模型能否在“时间连续展开、须从交互中推断”的场景下协调。此外，LLM 只是离散提示，CUA 也只能看到离散截图，因此需先回答“当前 AI 是否是与人类同类的时间推理者”。

Method: 任务：简化版 The Mind，两名玩家，牌面 1–100，10 个关卡，第 n 关各发 n 张牌，共同目标为按升序打完全部 110 张牌；无回合、无任何显式沟通，唯一可用信号是上一张牌打出后经过的时间；抢在对方之前打出更大牌即为错误并被强制翻出更小的牌。对手为 5 种规则策略：Linear（等待时间∝牌差×节奏参数 τ）、Bayesian（用 Weibull 生存函数建模对手沉默，先验为对手最小剩余牌的超几何式分布，达到置信阈值 θ=0.85 即出手）、Random（每秒 0.5 概率出手），并在 ±Calibration 条件下用 EMA（η=0.3）在线更新 τ；参数 τ=0.5、γ=2。策略拟合：对每局记录用 6 类策略（Random、Constant Wait、Linear±、Bayesian±）计算似然，以 AIC 选模型（BIC 在 80.3% 记录上给出一致结论）。适应分析：把 110 张牌按十等分，用 GLMM（随机截距：participant / prompt_type）建模十分位对标准化犹豫时间（按牌差归一化）与成功率的影响；另做错误归因（前 1/3 与后 1/3 配对 t 检验）。参与者：150 人（Prolific，含理解题与注意力检查），3 个 CUA（Gemini-3.7-flash、GPT-5.6-luna、GPT-6-astra，通过同一 GUI 实时操作）、10 个指令型 LLM（GPT-6-astra、GPT-5.6-luna、Gemini-3.7-flash、gpt-oss-120b/20b、Qwen3-32B/8B、Llama-3.1-70b/8b、LLaMa-3.2-1b），另含 LLM-LLM 与跨性能配对；LLM 提示条件分 Time-based（1s / 0.5s / 0.25s / 直接生成等待时长估计）与 Wait-based（等待次数计数、WAIT token 序列）。

Result: RQ1 表现：三类玩家在“成功率—完成时间”权衡下都以 Bayesian 对手为最佳搭档，说明人类与模型默认预期对手采用贝叶斯式时间推理；部分闭源 LLM 效率（z 分合成）高于人类，CUA 成功率可达人类水平但耗时显著更长。RQ2 策略：人类策略随对手灵活切换（面对 Random/无校准 Linear 时 Constant Wait 拟合最佳，面对复杂对手时 Bayesian 最佳）；LLM 与 CUA 倾向被单一策略拟合，且最佳拟合随模型族与规模变化——大模型多为 Bayesian，小模型多为 Random（Llama-70B 为 Linear、GPT-5.6-luna CUA 为 Constant）。RQ3 适应：人类在 Linear(−校准)（β̂=0.024, p=0.07）与 Bayesian(−校准)（β̂=0.062, p<0.01）条件下成功率显著提升，并与 Bayesian 对手合作时犹豫时间缩短（β̂=−0.11, p=0.08；−0.05, p=0.35）；人类是唯一在全部 5 类对手条件下成功率都随关卡推进上升的群体。错误归因显示人类错误率随对局下降（Linear 18.8%→12.6%, t(29)=2.73, p=.011；Bayesian 14.6%→10.7%, t(29)=2.60, p=.014），而规则对手错误率变化不足 1.5 个百分点（p>.49），证明改进来自人类自身适应而非对手校准；GPT-6 错误率几乎不变（9.5%→9.4%；10.0%→7.2%），显示适应有限；除 GPT-5.6-luna CUA 外，模型普遍表现为“更快但更差”或“更准但更慢”的权衡。RQ4 一致性：仅改变提示中时间的粒度即可显著改变行为（CV 差异大），模型可能依据“被提示等待的次数”而非真实时长决策；较大的模型对提示变化更稳健；Wait-based 提示在部分模型（如 GPT-5.6-luna）产生与 Time-based 相近的时序，说明 LLM 可能依靠数值信息而非真实时间推理即可完成任务。

Conclusion: 认知层面，人类在动态、无沟通的社会情境中自发进行隐式的贝叶斯概率推理（把对方的沉默当作关于其信念的证据），并且会对具体同伴进行在线、经验驱动的适应，这种机制甚至可能不依赖“连续实时体验”即可在模型中涌现；人类与模型所采用的推理形式相似，但形成该行为的过程（人类靠经验性适应，模型靠提示与内部表征）本质不同。实践层面，仅有提示的 LLM 反而达到人类可比的效率，而实时 CUA 表现更差，说明关键瓶颈不在实现延迟，而在对“隐式时间信号”的解读与在线适应能力；AI 要与人类或其他智能体高效协调，仍需学会解释并适应他人的隐式时间线索。同时本文首次系统研究了在“无其他沟通手段”条件下人类与 AI 如何利用时间实现复杂合作目标，并提出多个局限与未来方向：主要与规则化对手而非真人对真人配对、策略模型过度简化（未含策略混合与递归心智状态推理）、人类连续实时与 LLM 提示式离散时间的不对称，以及任务中时间信号与语言等其他线索相互隔离的现实效度问题。

Abstract: All social interactions are situated in time. Previous studies have shown that humans are able to use implicit temporal cues, such as the duration of a pause, to infer others' mental states. But how do humans use temporal cues for dynamic, fine-grained social coordination? And can AI systems do the same, without ``experiencing'' continuous real-time as humans do? We study these questions using a cooperative card game task called The Mind, which requires players to achieve a shared goal across repeated interactions but forbids explicit communication: the only available signal is the passage of time. We evaluate 150 humans, and two classes of AI models which reflect different ways of operationalizing time in artificial systems: computer-use agents (CUAs), and standard text-prompted LLMs. We find that human behavior is best captured by a Bayesian strategy that infers a partner's belief from their timing---and similarly for frontier models. However, unlike humans, none of the tested models seem to efficiently adapt their behaviors to their partners' over the course of the game. From a cognitive perspective, our findings suggest that humans perform implicit probabilistic reasoning about continuous-time signals in dynamic social settings, and that such reasoning mechanisms may emerge without real-time experience. Practically, our study highlights new challenges for AI systems to coordinate efficiently with other agents by learning to interpret and adapt to their implicit signals in dynamic settings.

</details>


### [447] [Leaderboard Hacking: Preference-Based Model Evaluations are Vulnerable to Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14769)
*Eve Fleisig,Joachim Baumann,Dylan Hadfield-Menell,Dirk Hovy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文（UC Berkeley、Bocconi、Stanford、MIT）系统证明了基于 Bradley-Terry (BT) 模型 / Elo 聚合的 LLM 竞技场排行榜（如 LMArena、Artificial Analysis、DesignArena）存在三类低成本操纵攻击：策略投票（strategic voting）、策略提名（strategic nomination）与策略提示（strategic prompting），二者组合最高可将模型排名提升 45 位。该漏洞源于 BT 目标等价于 Borda count，而 Borda count 在社会选择理论中已知可被策略性操纵；作者在 LMArena 公开的 10 万条人类偏好数据上验证攻击效果，分析可操纵性的影响因素，并给出算法与界面层面的防御方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 竞技场式排名（arena-style ranking）通过用户自由提问、对匿名模型的成对回答投票、再用 Bradley-Terry 模型聚合为统一榜单，已成为 LLM 评估的主流范式（LMArena、Artificial Analysis、DesignArena）。随着榜单影响力扩大（影响用户选择、企业宣传、融资与模型厂商收入），模型提供方有强烈动机以不诚信手段刷高排名。BT 模型隐式等价于 Borda count，而 Borda count 在社会选择文献中已知存在策略性投票（strategic voting）、策略性提名（strategic nomination）等可被操纵的弱点，因此作者假设并验证：任何允许开放式提示、投票或模型提交的 BT 偏好式榜单都会继承这些脆弱性。论文核心问题是：一个恶意行为者能多容易地欺诈性提升某目标模型的排名？

Method: 数据：LMArena 公开数据集 lmarena-ai/arena-human-preference-100k（超过 10 万条人类偏好，CC-BY-4.0），使用 BT/Elo 最大似然拟合（logistic 回归）。攻击一（策略投票）：比较贪心最佳投票（每票重算 Elo，昂贵，借鉴 Min et al.）与本文提出的高效启发式最佳投票规则——若目标模型 A 在比较对中则投 A，否则投较弱的模型（B 优于 C 时投 C），无需重算 Elo；同时给出模型去匿名化方法：开放权重模型用 teacher-forcing 的平均 token 级对数似然归因（精度>80%），专有 API 模型用字符级序列相似度（40–50%）。攻击二（策略提名）：对每个目标模型遍历候选模型（数据集内 55 个，线上约 300 个），找出加入其副本最能提升目标模型排名的模型 C，并加入 ≤10 份副本。攻击三（策略提示）：按语言划分提示子集（≥20 场战斗），选择目标模型相对表现最优的语言，插入 ≤10K 条已知结果的战斗（≈10% 数据）；另用 LMArena 预标注的复杂度/创造力/领域知识/数学标签做子类别验证。组合攻击：先提名再提示。分析：对最佳 Δrank 做岭回归（投票 R²=0.660、提示 R²=0.518、提名 R²=0.557），特征含胜率方差、起始排名与 Elo、模型族规模、与上一名模型的 Elo 差、胜率、战斗数、平局率、优势语言战斗数、改进的“Elo 密度”（Elo 高出 0–50 分的模型数）；做数据集规模 25%–200% 的缩放实验。防御：针对提名，用谐波 Borda（Dowdall）加权 BT，w_{m,β}=(1−β)+β/r(m)，β∈{0.25,0.5,0.75,1}，以 Kendall-τ 衡量与原排序距离（β=0.75 最佳：最大提升 15→8 位）；针对投票，要求登录验证、检测异常投票模式、限制只看不投；针对提示，对提示做分层/聚类并等权加权；附录 B 另提出核平滑（KDE-like）BT，把分数替换为“区域质量”以降低重复/聚簇比较的边际收益。
